ui.tr.title: Counter-buy
ui.tr.sub: A real high-rank game, frozen at one moment. Look at who is fed on the other side and what they bought, then pick the item to buy.
ui.tr.board_hint: Hover the bars to see the weapon / vitality / spirit investment, and the portrait for damage and healing.
ui.tr.question: Which item do you buy?
ui.tr.question_sub: Hover an item to see what it does. Think about the main threat on the other side.
ui.tr.v_perfect: Perfect: the stats and the pro agree
ui.tr.v_best: Well spotted: the best pick according to the stats
ui.tr.why: {item} is the counter item that wins the most against this team. The biggest share comes from {hero} ({souls} souls, {kda}, {share}% of the threat): against that hero, it wins {gain} pts more than usual.
ui.tr.pro_won: The {rank} player bought {item} right after, and their team won.
ui.tr.pro_lost: The {rank} player bought {item} right after, and their team lost.
ui.tr.score_note: Each item's score: its measured win-rate gain against each enemy hero (Phantom+, items bought after 10 min), weighted by that hero's threat at this moment (its souls). Gaps are often small: a trend, not a certainty. Best pick according to the stats: 3 points, pro's pick: 2 points.
ui.tr.final_sub: Play again to get other games.
ui.tr.how: The games are real Ascendant+ games from the last two weeks (deadlock-api), frozen at 15 or 20 min. The "best" item is picked among the counter items (anti-heal, anti-tank, resistances, status resistance) that players of your hero actually buy. The "pro's pick" is the item the player bought in the next two and a half minutes. No player name is shown.

ui.ctr.title: Counter items
ui.ctr.desc: Situational items {author} buys clearly more often against some heroes (purchase rate against that hero vs their overall rate). Computed on their games since {date}.
ui.pos.1: Takes the most souls on the team and wins the late game. Until ~15 min, mostly PvE (waves, side lane, camps). Their target in fights: the enemy carry.
ui.pos.2: Lots of souls, but a much earlier power spike (≈ 8 to 15 min): gank, take fights, force objectives. AFK farming at 12 min wastes that spike.
ui.pos.3: Average farm. Engages first, soaks damage and survives while the carries deal damage. After the lanes: split push and objectives.
ui.pos.4: Low farm. Leaves their lane to be where the fights are: ganks, picks, scouting. Farms on the move.
ui.pos.5: Low farm. Weakens enemies and buys team items (crowd control, hexes) to shut down the enemy carry.
ui.pos.6: The fewest souls. Heals, protects and saves the carries at the right time. Rule #1: don't die.
ui.pos.note: Positions 1 to 6 = farm priority in the community meta (the game enforces no role). P1 takes the most souls, P6 the fewest. Source: Steam guide “Roles Explained”.
